pr_title: GameEngine: show live benchmark campaign activity
pr_body:
## Summary

- add a bounded Live activity viewer beneath the existing campaign Progress matrix
- surface credential-safe Goose ACP activity from the active benchmark child plus managed llama-server tail output
- resolve Windows/WSL managed backend diagnostics inside ManagedLocalRuntime and keep WSL reads off the UI thread
- keep live diagnostics ephemeral so BenchmarkRecord, campaign checkpoint, Progress, and Report semantics stay unchanged

## Validation

Windows affected validation and an explicit running-campaign Editor visual capture are required.
